page.overview:
What is Deep Sea Explorers?

Deep Sea Explorers, also known as Deep Sea, is a City subtheme introduced in 2015. In 2020, the subtheme was revived under the new name Ocean. Starting in 2023, the subtheme would be succeeded by Explorer.

Deep Sea Explorers is a subtheme of LEGO City introduced in 2015 that features sets based around deep sea exploration. The sets featured underwater scenery, sea creatures and treasures and typically included minifigure divers.

The 2020 Ocean wave is licensed by National Geographic. It features LEGO City Adventures characters such as Jessica Sharpe and Harl Hubbs.
